description: Start a stopped server (billing for a started server resumes). Fails with 409 if it is not stopped. `async` returns immediately — poll upcloud_get_server for state=started. UpCloud: POST /1.3/server/{uuid}/start.

start_type.description: sync (default) waits for the start; async returns at once.

name: upcloud_start_server
title: Start a server
